name: CreditCard
description: A dark payment card with chip, number, holder and expiry, whose warm glow follows the pointer with smoothing and an optional 3D tilt, settling back to a soft rest glow when the pointer leaves.
a11yNotes: Exposed as a single role="img" with a descriptive label (brand, last four digits, holder, expiry) so the decorative layout isn't read piece by piece; the full number is never announced. Pointer effects are visual only, and under prefers-reduced-motion the tilt is disabled and the glow jumps without easing.

propsApi.name: brand
propsApi.description: Issuer text in the top-left corner.

propsApi.name: number
propsApi.description: Card number, spaces kept as typed.

propsApi.name: tilt
propsApi.description: Tilt the card in 3D toward the pointer.

propsApi.name: maskNumber
propsApi.description: Show only the last four digits.

propsApi.name: width
propsApi.description: Width in pixels; height follows the ISO card ratio.
